description.value: Merridale is a family-owned, woman-led farm cidery and distillery on a 20-acre orchard in the Cowichan Valley, crafting award-winning ciders and spirits for over 30 years. The property functions as a full farm destination with a farmhouse eatery, farm store, guided tastings, distillery tours, yurt accommodations, and seasonal events. Touring cyclists can settle in for a meal or tasting in an orchard setting, with dogs welcome on leash throughout the grounds and patio.

address.value: 1230 Merridale Road, Cobble Hill, B.C. V8H 1A1
